slides.title: Mean vs median: the outlier question is ==free points==
What an outlier does
slides.body: An outlier pulls the mean toward it. The median barely moves. Find the outlier and you already know which one is bigger.

slides.stem: Five salaries: \$40k, \$45k, \$50k, \$55k, \$500k. Which statement is true?
slides.prompt: No calculator needed. Comment your answer.

slides.trapWhy: "Cannot be determined" baits overthinkers. Nothing to compute — this is a reasoning question.
slides.intro: One giant outlier moves the mean and leaves the median alone.
steps: Median: the middle salary is $\$50\text{k}$, outlier or not
Mean: the $\$500\text{k}$ is added in, so it lands far above $\$50\text{k}$
